title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Rotate positions or settle in
hook: How many positions has each of your players tried?
intro: Your best outfielder asks to pitch.
statement: Young players learn the game by seeing it from different spots.
q1: Do you rotate every player through positions —
q2: or keep kids where they help the team most?
q3: At what age does that start to change?
t1: No single answer fits every team. But players grow
t2: when they understand the whole field.
ctaLines: Everyone tries every spot. Or set spots by midseason.
ctaPrompt: Share your lineup habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How many positions has each of your players tried?
Your best outfielder asks to pitch. The game is close.
Young players learn the game by seeing it from different spots.
Rotate positions or keep kids where they are strong. Every team is different.
Do you rotate positions? Share your habit in the comments.
